_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the garment taxonomy the user can select, what the drafting engine supports, and which combinations can be drafted. Read by backend/app/logic/feature_schema.py and frontend/src/utils/designSchema.js. The AI models suggest these values (garment 2 classes, neckline 4, sleeve length 3, sleeve style 2; 'none' is not predicted - it follows from 'sleeveless'). Change it only together with the engine and its tests.

garment_type.label: Blouse
garment_type.note: Woven bodice block with waist darts; hem must reach the waist line.

garment_type.label: T-Shirt
garment_type.note: Knit bodice block, no darts, neckband piece; hem must reach the waist line.

neckline_type.label: V-Neck
neckline_type.note: True V: straight edges to a centre-front point.

neckline_type.label: Square Neck
neckline_type.note: Square front neck with straight edges.

neckline_type.label: Collared Neck
neckline_type.note: No collar piece is generated yet; the pattern cannot be drafted.

sleeve_length.label: Sleeveless
sleeve_length.note: No sleeve piece; armhole facing strips are generated.

sleeve_length.label: Short Sleeve
sleeve_length.note: The sleeve length you enter (shoulder tip to sleeve hem); straight, no taper.

sleeve_length.label: Long Sleeve
sleeve_length.note: The sleeve length you enter (shoulder tip to sleeve hem), tapering to the wrist.

sleeve_style.label: Puff Sleeve
sleeve_style.note: Cap spread to 1.5x and crown raised 2.5 cm; the extra cap length is gathered between the notches. Short: hem gathered into a sleeve band. Long: tapers to the wrist.

outside_scope_message: The detected feature is outside the supported pattern scope. Please confirm the design manually.
low_confidence_message: Low confidence — please confirm this feature
